maintainedSuccessor.finding: Active successor has no evidenced UserUnit fix: dimension calculation still uses intersected page boxes and rotation without UserUnit. Successor binary not tested here.

officialAPI.finding: Header describes point dimensions and intrinsic rotation. Implementation forwards page dimensions from intersected CropBox/MediaBox, without UserUnit scaling. No public UserUnit accessor found.

unresolvedDecision: Obtain a maintained, auditable build exposing scalar UserUnit metadata from PDFium's parsed page dictionary, with complete notices and current fixes, before implementing migration. No custom PDF syntax parser or second production-engine workaround. A small bridge is a possible remedy, not a tested fix.
